title.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广：差二短窗
title.en: New route · Methods from the Levent GRH project and their extensions at gap two

description.zh: 在同一差二短窗减去高次素数幂与端点误差，用真实素数权验证近平方根的短除数和、半素数预算与局部 Fourier 输入。
description.en: Use the same gap-two window to bound proper powers and endpoint losses. Test the near-square-root divisor cutoff, semiprime bounds and local Fourier inputs with the actual prime weights.
